questions.q: EWMA with α = 0.5 over 8, 4: what is the second estimate (first is 8)?
Which α gives the smoothest EWMA?
why: Correct: it keeps 95% of the old estimate.

questions.q: Token bucket: capacity 2, rate 1/s, start full. Requests at t = 0, 0, 0. Results?
why: Correct: two tokens are spent, the third request finds none.

questions.q: Scenario: a fixed-window limiter allows 100 requests per minute. A client sends 100 at 12:00:59 and 100 at 12:01:00. What is the problem?
options: 200 requests in two seconds are allowed

questions.q: Scenario: sensor data arrive at random times. You want a smooth level that forgets old data at a fixed speed in real time. What do you use?
options: EWMA with a fixed α per sample
why: The speed of forgetting depends on the sample rate then.

questions.q: In the token bucket, what happens if you forget the `min(capacity, ...)` clamp?
options: After a long pause the bucket allows a huge burst
